# Sofascore

> Sofascore is a comprehensive live sports scoring platform covering 600+ leagues across football, tennis, ice hockey, baseball, handball, volleyball, MMA and more with real-time results, fixtures, statistics, and player ratings.

Sofascore provides global sports fans with instant access to live scores, match statistics, player ratings, and tournament coverage across multiple sports disciplines. The platform features personalized tracking, AI-powered trending event discovery, and detailed performance analytics for professional leagues worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Live Scores
- Real-time Results
- Football/Soccer
- Tennis
- Ice Hockey
- Premier League
- UEFA Champions League
- LaLiga
- Bundesliga
- Serie A
- ATP/WTA
- Match Statistics
- Player Ratings
- Sports Tracking
- Tournament Coverage

## Football & Soccer

- [Football Live Scores, Fixtures & Odds](https://www.sofascore.com): Homepage with live football scores from 600+ leagues including Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga, and international competitions
- [Favorites](https://www.sofascore.com/favorites): Personalized favorites page for tracking selected teams and competitions with live updates
- [Trending](https://www.sofascore.com/trending): AI-powered trending events discovery with location-based tournament visibility and match recommendations

## Tennis

- [Tennis Live Scores and Schedule](https://www.sofascore.com/tennis): Tennis live scores from 500+ ATP and WTA tournaments with rankings, statistics, and player tracking

## Ice Hockey & Winter Sports

- [Ice Hockey Live Scores and Schedule](https://www.sofascore.com/ice-hockey): Ice hockey live scores for NHL, KHL, SHL and international leagues with match statistics

## Combat & Racquet Sports

- [MMA Schedule, Results & Rankings](https://www.sofascore.com/mma): MMA scores and rankings from UFC, Bellator, KSW and PFL with fighter tracking and performance stats
- [Table Tennis Live Scores and Schedule](https://www.sofascore.com/table-tennis): Table tennis live scores and results from international tournaments with player statistics

## Team Sports

- [Baseball Live Scores & Schedule](https://www.sofascore.com/baseball): Baseball live scores including MLB, LMB, and Pro Yakyu with detailed statistics and standings
- [Handball Live Scores & Matches](https://www.sofascore.com/handball): Handball live scores from Bundesliga, EHF Champions League and major international leagues
- [Volleyball Live Scores & Schedule](https://www.sofascore.com/volleyball): Volleyball live scores from CEV Champions League and major international leagues with match details
